## Experience

- **SAP SE** — GenAI and Software Developer, Working Student (Mar 2025 to
  present). Production GenAI and data services for enterprise knowledge
  operations: LLM-powered review workflows on SAP Generative AI Hub,
  documentation quality and governance pipelines, and backend services on
  SAP BTP. Python, FastAPI, SAP HANA, SAP BTP Kyma, Docker, OAuth.
- **RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau** — Master's Thesis Researcher, Machine
  Learning / AI (Nov 2025 to May 2026), conducted with DFKI SmartFactory-KL.
  Thesis: "Differential Privacy in Vision-Language Models: Exploring the
  Privacy-Utility Trade-off for Technical Drawing Image Captioning."
  Fine-tuning, synthetic data generation, privacy-preserving training, and a
  custom evaluation suite. PyTorch, Hugging Face, PEFT/LoRA, Opacus.
- **DFKI (German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence)** — Research
  Assistant, Computer Vision, Augmented Vision group (Jun 2024 to Dec 2024).
  Transformer-based object detection for multi-modal medical image and video
  data. PyTorch, object detection, semi-supervised learning, HPC.
- **DFKI** — Research Project, AI / Computer Vision, Smart Data & Knowledge
  Services (May 2024 to Oct 2024). Built the ViT Token Analysis Toolkit for
  layer-wise analysis of token importance in Vision Transformers. PyTorch,
  timm, HDF5, SLURM, distributed training.
- **Cognizant Technology Solutions** — Software Engineer, Chennai (Aug 2020 to
  Feb 2023). Production .NET applications, backend features, and database and
  service performance work for enterprise systems. .NET, C#, SQL, Power BI.

## Projects

- [EvalGate](https://github.com/binoy-sasmal/evalgate-rag): a RAG service over
  the EU AI Act with evaluation built into the development loop, so retrieval
  and answer quality stay visible as the system changes. FastAPI, pgvector,
  hybrid search, Ragas evaluation gate.
- [OData MCP](https://github.com/binoy-sasmal/odata-mcp): a Model Context
  Protocol server exposing read-only OData v4 services as typed tools, with
  Zod validation and clean separation between protocol and data access.
  TypeScript.
- [Docket](https://github.com/binoy-sasmal/docket-agent): an invoice-exception
  agent that investigates ERP context, cites evidence, and proposes the next
  action while keeping final posting under human control. LangGraph.
- [Graph RAG](https://github.com/binoy-sasmal/graphrag-neo4j): a research-paper
  assistant using a Neo4j knowledge graph for questions where relationships
  matter as much as semantic similarity. Cypher plus vector retrieval.
- All repositories: https://github.com/binoy-sasmal
